fields.name: item_no
fields.description: IKEA article number (8 digits). The same number is the same article in every country.

fields.name: item_type
fields.description: ART = single article; SPR = combination of several articles sold as one product.

fields.name: parent_item_no
fields.description: Article number of the product this row is a colour/size variant of (equals item_no for the main product).

fields.name: is_main_variant
fields.description: True for the product's main variant, false for its other colour/size variants.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Product range name, e.g. KALLAX.

fields.name: type_name
fields.description: Product type, e.g. 'Shelving unit', in the country's language.

fields.name: design
fields.description: Colour / design text, e.g. 'white stained oak effect'.

fields.name: measure
fields.description: Main measurement as shown, e.g. '77x147 cm'.

fields.name: option_colour
fields.description: Colour option this variant represents among the product's variants.

fields.name: option_size
fields.description: Size option this variant represents among the product's variants.

fields.name: variant_count
fields.description: Number of variants of the product (main variant included).

fields.name: product_url
fields.description: Product page on the country's IKEA website.

fields.name: country
fields.description: ISO country code.

fields.name: country_name
fields.description: Country name.

fields.name: language
fields.description: Language of names, types and categories.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO currency of the prices.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Current selling price in local currency.

fields.name: original_price
fields.description: Previous price when the price was lowered; empty otherwise.

fields.name: discount_pct
fields.description: 1 - price / original_price, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when not reduced.

fields.name: price_tags
fields.description: Price labels: NEW_PRODUCT, NEW_LOWER_PRICE, TIME_RESTRICTED_OFFER, FAMILY_PRICE (IKEA Family member price), DISCONTINUED_PRODUCT, LOWER_CURRENT_REGULAR_PRICE_IN_STORE, COMING_SOON. Every reduced price carries one of them.

fields.name: price_valid_from
fields.description: Start of the current price's validity, when published.

fields.name: price_valid_to
fields.description: End of the current price's validity, when published.

fields.name: rating
fields.description: Average customer rating (1-5).

fields.name: rating_count
fields.description: Number of customer ratings.

fields.name: online_sellable
fields.description: False when the article is sold in stores only.

fields.name: last_chance
fields.description: True when the article is being discontinued.

fields.name: top_category
fields.description: Top-level category, e.g. 'Storage furniture'.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Leaf category.

fields.name: category_path
fields.description: Category path from top level to leaf, separated by ' > '.

fields.name: business_area
fields.description: IKEA home furnishing business, e.g. 'Bedroom furniture'.

fields.name: product_range_area
fields.description: IKEA product range area, e.g. 'Chests & other furniture'.

fields.name: product_area
fields.description: IKEA product area, e.g. 'Chest of drawers'.

fields.name: image_url
fields.description: Main product image URL.

fields.name: image_urls
fields.description: All product image URLs.

fields.name: image_count
fields.description: Number of product images.

fields.name: collected_at
fields.description: When this record was collected (UTC).
